mapper.insert: insert into hotplace (place_name, category, address, overview, pos, api_source, is_pet_friendly) values ( #{placeName}, #{category}, #{address}, #{overview}, #{pos, javaType=org.locationtech.jts.geom.Point, typeHandler=com.ssafy.passproject.handler.JtsPointTypeHandler}, #{apiSource}, #{isPetFriendly} )
mapper.update: update hotplace set place_name=#{placeName}, category=#{category}, address=#{address}, overview=#{overview}, pos=#{pos, javaType=org.locationtech.jts.geom.Point, typeHandler=com.ssafy.passproject.handler.JtsPointTypeHandler}, api_source=#{apiSource}, is_pet_friendly=#{isPetFriendly} where place_id=#{placeId}
mapper.select: SELECT place_id, place_name, category, address, overview, image, pos, api_source, is_pet_friendly, avg_rating FROM hotplace WHERE category = #{category}
SELECT h.*, r.* FROM hotplace h LEFT JOIN review r ON h.place_id = r.place_id WHERE h.place_id = #{placeId}

SELECT place_id, place_name, category, address, overview, image, pos, api_source, is_pet_friendly, avg_rating FROM hotplace WHERE -- 1차 필터: MBR로 공간 인덱스 활용 MBRContains( ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT( 'POLYGON((', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{maxLon}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{maxLon}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, '))' ), 4326), pos ) -- 2차 필터: 정확한 거리 계산 (MBR 통과한 데이터만) AND ST_Distance_Sphere( pos, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{currentLat}, ' ', #{currentLon}, ')'), 4326) ) <= #{radiusMeters} ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere( pos, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{currentLat}, ' ', #{currentLon}, ')'), 4326) )
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hotplace WHERE -- 1차 필터: MBR로 공간 인덱스 활용 MBRContains( ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT( 'POLYGON((', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{maxLon}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{maxLon}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, '))' ), 4326), pos ) -- 2차 필터: 정확한 거리 계산 AND ST_Distance_Sphere( pos, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{currentLat}, ' ', #{currentLon}, ')'), 4326) ) <= #{radiusMeters}

SELECT place_id, place_name, category, address, overview, image, pos, api_source, is_pet_friendly, avg_rating FROM hotplace WHERE -- 1차 필터: MBR로 공간 인덱스 활용 MBRContains( ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT( 'POLYGON((', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{maxLon}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{maxLon}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, '))' ), 4326), pos ) -- 2차 필터: 정확한 거리 계산 AND ST_Distance_Sphere( pos, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{currentLat}, ' ', #{currentLon}, ')'), 4326) ) <= #{radiusMeters} -- 3차 필터: 카테고리 AND category = #{category} ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere( pos, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{currentLat}, ' ', #{currentLon}, ')'), 4326) )
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hotplace WHERE -- 1차 필터: MBR로 공간 인덱스 활용 MBRContains( ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT( 'POLYGON((', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{maxLon}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{maxLon}, ',', #{maxLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, ',', #{minLat}, ' ', #{minLon}, '))' ), 4326), pos ) -- 2차 필터: 정확한 거리 계산 AND ST_Distance_Sphere( pos, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{currentLat}, ' ', #{currentLon}, ')'), 4326) ) <= #{radiusMeters} -- 3차 필터: 카테곦0리 AND category = #{category}
SELECT * FROM hotplace WHERE place_name = #{placeName} AND ST_Equals(pos, #{pos, javaType=org.locationtech.jts.geom.Point, typeHandler=com.ssafy.passproject.handler.JtsPointTypeHandler}) LIMIT 1

SELECT place_id, place_name, category, address, overview, image, pos, api_source, is_pet_friendly, avg_rating, count FROM hotplace WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere( pos, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{currentLat}, ' ', #{currentLon}, ')'), 4326) ) <= #{radiusMeters} AND count > 0 ORDER BY count DESC, avg_rating DESC LIMIT #{limit}
